title: daphne indica subsp. linearifolia
intro: Daphne indica subsp. linearifolia, commonly known as the Himalayan daphne, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Thymelaeaceae. This plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it beneficial for various health concerns. The therapeutic actions of Daphne indica subsp. linearifolia include treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
